verses.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just as the second crop was coming up, after the king's share had been harvested.
When the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land, I cried out, "Lord GOD, please forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"
So the LORD changed his mind about this. "It will not happen," the LORD said.
This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It dried up the great deep and was about to burn up the land.
Then I cried out, "Lord GOD, please stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"
So the LORD changed his mind about this too. "This will not happen either," the Lord GOD said.
This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing beside a wall that had been built straight, with a plumb line in his hand.
The LORD asked me, "Amos, what do you see?" I answered, "A plumb line." Then the Lord said, "Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel. I will no longer pass over their sins.
The high places of Isaac will be destroyed, and the holy places of Israel will be ruined. I will attack the family of Jeroboam with the sword."
Then Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: "Amos is plotting against you right in the middle of Israel. The land cannot put up with all his words.
This is what Amos is saying: 'Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely be taken away from their land into exile.'"
Then Amaziah said to Amos, "Get out of here, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your living there and do your prophesying there.
Do not prophesy at Bethel anymore, because this is the king's holy place and the temple of the kingdom."
Amos answered Amaziah, "I was not a prophet or the son of a prophet. I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore fig trees.
But the LORD took me away from tending the flock and said to me, 'Go, prophesy to my people Israel.'
So now listen to the message of the LORD. You say, 'Do not prophesy against Israel, and stop preaching against the descendants of Isaac.'

So this is what the LORD says: 'Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will be killed by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a foreign land. And Israel will surely be taken away from their land into exile.'"
